idx_cooking_queue_user_position.name: idx_cooking_queue_user_position
idx_cooking_queue_user_position.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('waiting', 'preparing', 'ready', 'cooking')

idx_cooking_queue_active_recipe.name: idx_cooking_queue_active_recipe
idx_cooking_queue_active_recipe.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('waiting', 'preparing', 'ready', 'cooking')

cooking_queue_items_check_2.name: cooking_queue_items_check_2
cooking_queue_items_check_2.value: meal_type IS NULL OR meal_type IN ('breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner', 'snack')

idx_household_shopping_name.name: idx_household_shopping_name
idx_household_shopping_name.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND transferred_at IS NULL

idx_household_shopping_active.name: idx_household_shopping_active
idx_household_shopping_active.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND transferred_at IS NULL

inventory_outcome_events_check_4.name: inventory_outcome_events_check_4
inventory_outcome_events_check_4.value:
(scope = 'personal' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND inventory_item_id IS NOT NULL AND household_id IS NULL AND household_inventory_item_id IS NULL)
             OR (scope = 'household' AND household_id IS NOT NULL AND household_inventory_item_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL AND inventory_item_id IS NULL)

recipe_kitchenware_requirements_check_3.name: recipe_kitchenware_requirements_check_3
recipe_kitchenware_requirements_check_3.value: catalog_id IS NOT NULL OR capability_code IS NOT NULL
